risk_note: RV2 settlement + ledger (B2-04zzl; BR-ATTR-26, BR-FUND-08 R8 BLACKLIST_CONFIRMED; D10-1035, D10-1095). A new consumer of order.blacklist_hit_after_credit re-reads the order under the settlement lock and, while it is still CREDITED, registers a blacklist_after_credit recon diff (R3; ref_id {order_key}#BLACKLIST#{sorted dimensions}; idempotent by dedupe key); it freezes nothing and posts nothing. The new admin operation blacklistClawbackAdminReconDiff (order.blacklist_clawback, totp, Idempotency-Key, switch order.blacklist_clawback.enabled, unset = off) re-checks the order and calls clawback.apply with the new cause BLACKLIST_CONFIRMED: R8, sub_type FULL, reason BLACKLIST, amounts as for any whole-order clawback, voucher event id B{recon_diff_id}. The diff becomes adjusted in the same transaction. The request body is validated after the permission and step-up checks (contract check order). No user-facing text added: BR-TEXT-05 BLACKLIST and BR-TEXT-19 CLAWBACK already cover it.
